o1: Predicted to enable cullin family protein binding activity. Predicted to contribute to ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be involved in protein ubiquitination. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to human SKP1 (S-phase kinase associated protein 1).
